title: I asked Claude to build a 3D car mechanic game. It worked.
author: Famous-Stable-8092
selftext:
I just released a 3D car mechanic game called \*\*Clunker Clinic\*\*, a free browser game where you diagnose and fix broken cars, then grow your workshop into a business. 



Feel free to check it out: [https://gamer82901.itch.io/clunker-clinic](https://gamer82901.itch.io/clunker-clinic)



\*\*What you do:\*\*

\- Customers come in with vague complaints ("It just clicks in the morning", "The heater blows cold air"). You find the real fault with an OBD scanner, measurements and test drives.

\- 30+ fault types: batteries, brake pads, thermostats, water pumps, DPF, clutch…

\- Take parts off, torque them to spec, put everything back.

\- Business side: buy lifts and pits, hire mechanics, switch on manager mode and let them run the shop, open new branches, flip junkyard cars.



\*\*How it was made:\*\*

\- Code and in-game text written with Claude (Anthropic). I directed the design, played it constantly, reported bugs and decided what stays.

\- three.js for 3D. All cars, the garage, the mechanics and the textures are built procedurally in code. Sounds are synthesized with Web Audio.

\- The whole game is one HTML file (\~1.3 MB). No download, works on desktop and mobile.



\*\*What worked well with AI:\*\*

\- Iterating fast on systems: diagnostics, staff AI and the economy inside the game.

\- Automated browser tests to catch regressions after every change.



\*\*What was hard:\*\*

\- Getting visuals to look right without image assets (mechanic arms clipping into cars was a long fight 😅).

\- Keeping the UI readable on phones with so many systems.



I'd love to hear your feedback. What would you add or change?

comments.author: SuperHornetFA18
comments.body: As a proof of concept it definitely worked. Now polish it, make the fine tuning, bug/stress test it so it can even run on a potato and then we can call it a full game.

replies.author: Famous-Stable-8092
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback, I will definitely take it into consideration as I am working on improving the game.
